svg.title: Observe. Modify. Validate.
svg.desc: A small vehicle context and a separate ECU connect through a logical ESPCars gateway between two CAN segments. The device is represented by an application block and bridge, filter and signal-rewrite blocks, with runtime values and optional CRC-8 correction. Separate CCP access supports measurement and opt-in calibration writes. There are no PCB renderings or function locations inside the vehicle.

g.text: An inline CAN gateway for signal adaptation, integration tests and tuning experiments.
Observe, modify and validate with local controls and recording.
